project.name: spring-boot-restless-dependencies
project.description: Bill of materials for spring-boot-restless: import this into a consuming application's own <dependencyManagement> to pull in matching, tested-together versions of "spring-boot-restless" (the core library), "spring-boot-restless-cerbos" (optional Cerbos-backed authorization), and "spring-boot-restless-test" (MockMvc/AssertJ test helpers) without hand-pinning each one's version separately. Deliberately no <parent> (a BOM's whole point is being importable by a consumer whose own parent is something else entirely, e.g. their own company parent POM) and no <dependencies> - only <dependencyManagement>, so importing it never forces any of these three artifacts onto the classpath by itself; a consumer still declares whichever ones they actually want, just without a version.
